title: Haunted Casino
native_title: ホーンテッド・カジノ
overview:
The last 18+ software. The last of eros. Here, we can't show you any more than this.

Haunted Casino is an adult card and table game set in a mansion run by witches who prey on men. You walk the halls through full-motion video, guided by the bat-like servant Babel, while suits of armor seem to watch your every step and the remains of those who lost their souls lie in coffins.

Your stake is your own soul, paid out as soul coins. Sit down with the demonic dealers - mermaid, harpy, cat and dragon among them - at blackjack, poker, roulette and Hell or Heaven. Every time a dealer loses she sheds another piece of clothing, and taking all her coins seals her into a card. Clear every table on a floor to earn the key to the next, and climb all three floors toward the queen of the casino.

- Dealer artwork drawn in 32,000 colors
- 3D sound that whispers right at your ear
- Projection room for viewing defeated dealers
- Three discs, one floor of the mansion on each
